Root.closeParentOnEsc.semantic: in a submenu: Escape closes the whole menu tree vs only the child menu.

Root.triggerId / defaultTriggerId.semantic: which trigger owns the controlled/uncontrolled open state (multi-trigger menus).

Root.handle.semantic: detached triggers: createHandle() then pass to Root and to triggers rendered outside it; handle.open(triggerId)/close()/isOpen.

Root.loopFocus.semantic: arrow keys wrap at the ends.

Root.modal.semantic: true locks page scroll + outside pointer interaction; nested menus ignore it and hover-opened menus are never modal.

Root.orientation.semantic: chooses the roving-focus axis (up/down vs left/right).

Root.children.semantic: children may be a render function receiving the active trigger's payload.

Trigger.disabled / handle / payload / de.type: boolean / MenuHandle / Payload / number / number / boolean / boolean
Trigger.disabled / handle / payload / de.semantic: openOnHover opens the menu on hover; delay/closeDelay tune it; nativeButton=false when rendering a non-button.

Positioner.side / align.semantic: plus the full anchor-positioning set: sideOffset, alignOffset, anchor, arrowPadding, collisionAvoidance, collisionBoundary, collisionPadding, sticky, positionMethod, disableAnchorTracking.

Item.label.semantic: text used for keyboard typeahead matching.

Item.closeOnClick.semantic: closes the menu when the item is clicked; CheckboxItem/RadioItem default to FALSE.

Item.onClick.semantic: menu items fire onClick; there is no onAction.

CheckboxItem.checked / defaultChecked /.semantic: controlled/uncontrolled tick state; closeOnClick defaults false so the menu stays open.

RadioItem.value / label / disabled / clo.semantic: value is required; closeOnClick defaults false.

LinkItem.semantic: navigational item; state {disabled, highlighted}; use `render` to swap in a framework Link.

SubmenuRoot.semantic: groups a nested menu; doesn't render an element.

SubmenuTrigger.openOnHover / delay / clo.semantic: opens the submenu on hover and on ArrowRight/ArrowDown.

Viewport.children.semantic: transition container required only when one popup has multiple triggers, content changes per trigger, and switching is animated; state exposes activationDirection/transitioning/instant.

Popup / Portal / Backdrop / Arrow / Grou.type: styling + render; Portal has container; Popup emits data-instant ('click'|'dismiss'|'group'|'trigger-change')
Popup / Portal / Backdrop / Arrow / Grou.semantic: Popup is the menu container (data-instant disables animations for a given interaction).

Menu.createHandle() / Handle.semantic: imperative/detached trigger control: open(triggerId), close(), isOpen; calls before a root attaches are ignored.

dataAttributes: CheckboxItemIndicator: data-checked, data-unchecked, data-disabled, data-starting-style, data-ending-style
RadioItemIndicator: data-checked, data-unchecked, data-disabled, data-starting-style, data-ending-style
Positioner: data-open, data-closed, data-anchor-hidden, data-side, data-align
Popup: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-side, data-align, data-instant ('click'|'dismiss'|'group'|'trigger-change')
Arrow: data-open, data-closed, data-side, data-align, data-uncentered
Root / Portal / Group / GroupLabel / Separator / RadioGroup / RadioItem / Viewport: no data-* of their own (Viewport exposes state, not attributes, in the typings)
renderProp: Shared `render` prop on every part (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement). Detached/composed triggers are the documented pattern: pass a handle (Menu.createHandle()) to both <Menu.Root handle> and triggers outside it; `<Menu.Trigger render={<MyButton/>}>` composes with your own component. Custom primitives: useRender; merging: mergeProps/mergePropsN (handlers merged right-to-left, className concatenated, style merged, ref not merged).
controlled: `open`/`defaultOpen` + `onOpenChange(open, eventDetails)` and `onOpenChangeComplete(open)`; multi-trigger controlled mode pairs `open` with `triggerId` (and `defaultTriggerId` for uncontrolled). CheckboxItem uses checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange; RadioGroup uses value/defaultValue/onValueChange; SubmenuRoot mirrors open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange. Imperative: actionsRef {unmount, close} and the Handle class.
formIntegration: None — menus are not form controls. There is no name/value submission, hidden input, or validation state; item state is data-highlighted/data-disabled/data-checked only.
keyboard: List navigation comes from floating-ui-react's useListNavigation/useTypeahead: ArrowUp/ArrowDown (or ArrowLeft/ArrowRight when `orientation='horizontal'`) move the roving highlight, Home/End jump to the first/last item, printable characters run typeahead against item text or the item's `label` prop (session reset after 500 ms; Space continues an in-progress session). Enter/Space activate the highlighted item. Escape closes the menu (closeParentOnEsc controls whether the whole submenu tree closes). Submenus open with ArrowRight (ArrowDown for horizontal menus, RTL-aware) and close with ArrowLeft/ArrowUp or Escape; Shift+Tab closes the submenu; a modal menu traps/returns focus (FloatingFocusManager + finalFocus-style handling). No PageUp/PageDown handling in 1.8.0.
notableDifferences: Root is a non-rendering state container; composition is Root > Trigger + Portal > (Backdrop) > Positioner > Popup > (Arrow) — there is no React Aria `Popover`/`MenuTrigger`+`Popover` pairing and no `trigger` render prop (use `render` or a detached `handle`).
Item activation is a plain onClick; React Aria's onAction + shouldCloseOnSelect maps to onClick + `closeOnClick`.
Typeahead text override is `label` (React Aria: textValue); CheckboxItem/RadioItem default `closeOnClick=false`, plain Item defaults true.
Submenus are explicit parts (SubmenuRoot/SubmenuTrigger) rather than nested <Menu> elements; the submenu's Positioner side/align defaults change to 'inline-end'/'start'.
Multiple/detached triggers are first-class via Menu.createHandle() + Root.handle/triggerId + Trigger.handle/payload — React Aria has no equivalent (it uses multiple MenuTrigger inside one Menu).

Menus are modal by default (scroll lock + outside pointer blocking), and open-on-hover is opt-in per trigger via `openOnHover`/`delay`/`closeDelay` on the Trigger (React Aria puts these on the trigger too, but with different defaults and no data-instant animation switches).
State vocabulary: data-highlighted / data-disabled / data-checked / data-popup-open / data-instant; no data-focused, no data-placement (it is data-side/data-align).
